parameters.name: CommandName
parameters.description:
The name of the command to trigger.

> Call the [DescribeSophonCommands](~~DescribeSophonCommands~~) operation to obtain the command name.

parameters.name: InputParams
parameters.description: The input parameters to trigger the command or playbook.

parameters.name: SophonTaskId
parameters.description: A custom ID for the task. If you do not specify this parameter when you trigger the playbook, a random ID is generated. You can use the ID to locate and troubleshoot issues.

parameters.name: TriggerType
parameters.description:
The trigger type. Valid values:

- **command**: triggers a command task

- **playbook**: triggers a playbook task

parameters.name: Uuid
parameters.description:
The UUID of the playbook.

> Call the [DescribePlaybooks](~~DescribePlaybooks~~) operation to obtain the playbook UUID.
